h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Bidhannagar

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Bidhannagar

items.pText: Bidhannagar, better known as Salt Lake, is a planned township on the eastern edge of Kolkata. Its residential blocks are arranged around small parks, and the IT offices of Sector V sit on one side. FunPlay Systems supplies outdoor playground equipment to residents' associations, schools, clubs and corporate campuses in Salt Lake from our factory in Vasai, about 1,650 km away, sent by road.

Many Salt Lake block parks are looked after by the residents themselves, through a block committee. Committees usually want three things: equipment that lasts, a fair price and a layout everyone can agree on. We help by sending a layout drawing that members can review together, with every safe play area marked and the equipment list clearly set out. Once the committee approves it, we take the order forward.

richText.heading: Upgrading a block park in Salt Lake

c: Many block parks already have old equipment. Before you order, decide what stays and what goes. Rusted metal swings and cracked fibreglass slides are better replaced than repaired.
Send us photos of the park showing the existing pieces, trees and paths. We plan new equipment around the trees and the walking track, keeping benches outside the safe play areas. A

items.q: Can you replace old equipment in our block park?
items.a: Yes. Share photos of the park and the existing equipment. We suggest which pieces to replace and plan the new layout around trees, paths and benches.

items.q: How do we get a block committee to agree on a layout?
items.a: Our layout drawing shows each piece, its safe play area and the equipment list in one sheet. Committee members can review it together and ask us for changes before approving.

items.q: Do you supply playground equipment in Salt Lake?
items.a: Yes. We manufacture at our Vasai factory and send the equipment to Bidhannagar by road. Our team or a West Bengal dealer installs it.
